Class Claims

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.Claims
public final class Claims extends Object
Land claims, for every plugin (API 24): who owns this place, and may this player do this here? Tempest Claims answers when it runs; else Simple Claims is read (a read-only link that switches itself off when that mod changes); else nobody owns anything and everything is allowed. No plugin talks to a claims mod directly, so no claims mod update can break a Tempest plugin. 
if (!Claims.may(player, world, x, y, z, Claims.Action.BUILD)) { ... refuse ... }
Claims.Owner owner = Claims.ownerAt(world, x, y, z);   // null in the wilderness
Asked from any thread, often: answers come from memory. Positions are blocks; a provider turns them into chunks with chunk(double) (floor, never a cast, so the negative side of x = 0 is its own chunk).

    • publicBlocks

      public static void publicBlocks(String plugin, Predicate<String> isBlock)
      Blocks every visitor may use in any claim (never break): a plugin's own blocks that check for themselves who may do what, such as shop stalls, ATMs, crate blocks and slot machines. Matched by the exact block id the plugin recognises, never by words in a name.
      Parameters:
      plugin - who registers them; a second call replaces the first
      isBlock - true for the plugin's block ids (and their states)
